mentions.story: The USSR used a nuclear charge to stop a gas well fire in 1966
mentions.why: Time-lapse of 2053 nuclear detonations, over 1000 by America.
mentions.quote: It really puts into perspective just how many nukes have gone off for purposes other than to kill people.
